Writing that lives in Google Docs rather than on this site. Each document is
edited in Google Docs and nothing is copied here. Sharing is set per document,
so a link may ask for permission.

## Documents

- [Buddhism Learning Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14Up3OtibQZ4KHY2_qfOR8BxgXQ2qfosHIusHyQEkxaU/edit),
  the way into the material and the document to read first.
- [Ten Oxherding Pictures](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qERHlZpMG5FBozOAq8dNRis74JEuVhfMfUw4_t9qFuY/edit),
  the Chan sequence on the stages of practice, from searching for the ox to
  returning to the world.
- [Eightfold Path](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xnLenURzCjYLszDHXXjXMKdYL3IBcBj82IvLzPqPNvY/edit),
  the eight factors of the fourth noble truth, from right view to right
  concentration.

The lines above describe the subject of each document rather than what the
document says about it, and need replacing once the documents are read.
